  Scenario: AC10 Each provided operation answers 401 without a valid credential (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/access-log and a request to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise carry no valid credential
    When each request is sent
    Then each answer is 401 and no entry of the store is returned or changed

  Scenario: AC11 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key appends no second entry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an entry is appended through the store with an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the replay appends no second entry and returns the entry of the first write
    And chain_seq and entry_hash of the store are unchanged by the replay
